reply: with an effective exponent near 2 at this scale. Its constants are not clean, so treat it as a numerical fit rather than a recognised closed form. The simpler forms I tested (fixed eps², a + bT^p + (c + dT^q)·eps²) reached NMSE around 1e-4. Their residuals still showed structure against temperature.
